title: Cafe Cuties!
description: Take a dive into the world of Cafe Cuties! Watch your world fill with various candy and food related creatures, friendly or not!
body:
# CAFE CUTIES!

![a gradient logo reading "CAFE CUTIES" in a pixelated font, stars decorating the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04d9bc61b109c70da999d79a766254870b9ce890.png)

Welcome to Cafe Cuties! This mod intends to add various food-fusion based critters, hopefully with servicable puns involved! Currently containing the Nyagiri, and with plans to add more in the future, step into the wonderful world of Cafe Cuties and see for yourself how hard it can be to decide between eating or taming the cutest little creatures!

Made using MCreator, Blockbench, and my husbands wonderful ability to be a rubberduck! Due to this no ports are planned, but anyone is open to contact me if they wish to make one!

**MOB VOTE! - YOU CAN DECIDE THE NEXT ADDITTION!**

[CLICK HERE TO VOTE ON THE NEXT CAFE-CUTIES MOB!](https://forms.gle/VU4G6k68uvLZcBHh9)
